hash_scope_note: The root-reported frozen hash is recorded as supplied. Executed module hashes below are SHA-256 of the imported conversational_search/intent.py file, and need not have the same scope.

methodology.authorship: The same model authored the expectation corpus before implementation freeze and adjudicated it afterward. Independent of implementation and existing tests during corpus authorship; not human validation and not an independent-human judge.
methodology.execution: Fresh IntentState per case; apply_user_message with successive messages and one-based turns; default parsing policy; no question context injected.
methodology.assessment_scope: Complete final IntentState semantic correctness against the entire frozen expected object, notes, and expected_semantics extension. Per-turn snapshots are additionally compared for baseline/candidate changes.
methodology.phrase_equivalence: Accept semantically equivalent category/attribute phrases, synonymous ordinary wording, and representations preserving the stated bounds and scope. Exact spelling and formatting are not required.
methodology.constraint_resolution: A required or preferred attribute must be represented as an active requirement/preference with identifiable attribute and strength; exclusions must be represented as exclusions. Keeping a whole conversation or command as untyped free text is not itself successful semantic resolution. Attributes embedded in a category description do not substitute for resolved active attributes, particularly after edits.
methodology.strength_handling: No failure is based solely on the literal strength='soft' field. The audit requires correct required-versus-preferred meaning and attribute scope; untyped whole-message importance labels cannot establish that distinction for individual clauses.
methodology.unsupported_references: When no item/photo context is supplied, do not invent it. Assess the frozen preservation expectation, while acknowledging that initial extraction failures can prevent this corpus from exercising later typed-attribute preservation.
methodology.unscorable_policy: Mark unscorable only when expected meaning remains ambiguous after reading notes and expected_semantics. Do not silently change expectations or add question context.
methodology.schema_review: Zero cases were unscorable. Cases 044 and 045 specify OR versus AND in notes and semantic extensions; case 002 specifies material scope; case 015 specifies total-budget scope. Other preference and reference details are explicitly stated. The attribute arrays alone are not a sufficient automatic oracle.
methodology.introduced_unsafe_destructive_edit_defin: A candidate-only loss, exclusion removal, or replacement of an established still-valid constraint relative to baseline. Exact equality of every observed state proves none were introduced on these supplied traces, without proving broad safety.

limitations: All 52 conversations are model-authored English examples, mostly furniture/home goods, apparel, and accessories. This is not a representative random sample or a multilingual evaluation.

The parent identified the task's frozen catalog as apparel after this corpus was authored. Many cases request products beyond that catalog. This is a scope limitation, not a reason to exclude cases or change expectations after observing results; all 52 remain in the reported denominator.
The author also adjudicated the cases; independence concerns implementation exposure during authorship, not independence of judges. No human reviewed these labels.
The evaluation calls only apply_user_message on IntentState. It does not evaluate downstream retrieval, product ranking, LLM interpretation of free text, or end-to-end user success.
No synthetic last_asked_attribute or product/photo context was added. The corpus consequently exposes weak initial natural-language extraction, which masks many intended edit-specific checks.

Every case fails complete semantic correctness, so this set has a floor effect and cannot establish which implementation handles typed edit scenarios better. Exact trace equality supplies only a bounded no-change observation.

Expectation arrays need their notes and semantic extensions for preferences, OR/AND, material scope, total budgets, appearance, brand, scent, and unresolved references. No expectations were revised after observing outputs.
Counts are descriptive for these 52 cases. There is no statistical significance, hidden-benchmark, hidden800, or population-performance claim.
